metaTitle: Custom Etched Office Gifts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom etched office gifts and awards for your team. Perfect for corporate recognition and branded desk accessories.
introHtml: Etching adds a permanent, elegant finish to office awards and desk accessories. Unlike printed logos, etched designs won't fade or peel, making them ideal for executive gifts like the Wave Award or Drake Globe Award. Choose etching for a sophisticated look on pens, bowls, and globes that will be displayed proudly for years.
heroAltText: Custom etched office gifts including a Wave Award and Drake Globe Award with permanent engraved logos
